name: Threads-TS-TW

frames.best_why: A wide crest of fine white threads rises across the frame, the fullest wave of the six.

tagline: Fine white threads roll into a slow wave across black.
summary: Forty hair-thin white lines weave into a ribbon that ripples across a black stage. Each strand drifts on its own, so the band swells into a crest and dips like cloth in wind.
appearance: A black stage carries a band of very fine white threads woven into a shallow wave. The bundle is dense on the right and thins into a single bright line on the left.
behaviour: The ribbon of threads ripples and rolls sideways, strands drifting at different rates so the band rises into a crest and settles again. The pointer bends the wave where it moves.
demo_content: White threads at amplitude 1 on a black panel with pointer interaction on.
search_phrases: thin white lines rippling on black
minimal white wave lines for a hero
use_when: A dark, minimal hero needs one delicate moving line to break the emptiness.
avoid_when: The band is thin and dim, so it vanishes behind busy content or on light pages.
customise: Colour, amplitude, strand spacing and pointer response are props; strand count and line widths are fixed in the shader.
weight_why: A fullscreen shader loops over 40 lines for every pixel on every frame.

a11y.note: A canvas backdrop with no labels; its constant drift ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Delicate threads with a smooth wave; the band is faint and fills only a thin strip.
title: Threads
